Stating the gate's own condition in the generation instruction should reduce DETERMINISTIC_MISMATCH and CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE without touching the gate.

whyUnitTestsMissedIt: Every gate was green when the change was committed. The regression lived entirely in real provider output quality, which only the cohort measurement exercises. Pinning the prompt prose in a test would have made this worse, not better: a prose test would have gone green on the new wording and lent the regression false authority.
standingConclusion: Cohort variance is now the whole story. The same code produced cohort B 10/10 in one session and 7/10 in the next, and a 20-run direct profile at the same commit produced 19/20. Per-run success sits between roughly 70% and 95% depending on the session, so a 10-run cohort reaching 10/10 is attainable but not dependable.
